parties.respondent: The High Court Of Manipur At Imphal & ANR

summary: Recruitment for District Judge (manipur judicial service): cut-off marks introduced via Full Court Resolution after written exam; whether executive instructions can override statutory rules under Article 234/309; legitimacy of 40% viva-voce cut-off not specified in original rules; procedural fairness; reliance on Sivanandan C.T. & Ors vs High Court of Kerala; amendment to rules post-recruitment; cumulative grading vs pass/fail standard; constitutional bench reference resolved by three-judge bench; legitimate expectation of candidate.
legal_provisions_cited: All India Judges Assn. v Union of India (2002) 4 SCC 247
Sivanandan C.T. & Ors vs High Court of Kerala & Ors (2023) SCC OnLine SC 994
Kavita Kamboj v. High Court of P&H (2024) 7 SCC 103
Abhimeet Sinha v High Court of Patna (2024) 7 SCC 262
final_judgment: Judgment delivered by three-judge bench resolving split verdict from 2016; Full Court Resolution prescribing 40% cut-off for viva-voce upheld as valid exercise of authority under MJS Rules 2005; writ petition dismissed; petitioner's rejection in judicial service recruitment upheld.
